description: Cases for engine/js/medicaid (the JS port of pp_engine.medicaid.exposure.scenario and rollup.roll_up), generated from the real FY2023 records by pp_pipeline.medicaid.conformance. A scenario case runs one hospital's base, share and the scenario's decline; a roll-up case rolls up all the hospitals for one scenario, use rate and revenue base. Expected keys are Python's (snake_case). Compare within 1e-6 relative (absolute when the expected value is 0); null must match exactly.
